title: RULES to Follow if You Wake Up in an Empty Mall at 3 A.M. #shorts
description_hook: You fell asleep on a mall bench. It's 3 A.M., every store is lit, and the music never stopped.

lines.say: Rule one. The escalators never stop. Only ride the one going down.
lines.img: an empty two-floor shopping mall at night, escalators running with no one on them, every storefront lit, glossy tiled floor reflecting the lights

lines.say: Rule two. Soft music plays from the ceiling. If it stops, freeze until it starts again.
lines.img: close-up of a round ceiling speaker in a mall, soft warm light, blurry empty corridor below

lines.text: DON'T LOOK AT THE MANNEQUINS TWICE
lines.say: Rule three. Look at the mannequins once. Never twice.
lines.img: a lit clothing store window at night with three faceless white mannequins, one turned slightly toward the glass, empty mall reflected

lines.say: Rule four. The food court is open. Don't eat anything that is still warm.
lines.img: an empty food court at night, rows of tables and chairs, one tray with a steaming paper cup in the middle, counters lit and unattended

lines.say: Rule five. The exit signs point the wrong way. Walk away from the green light.
lines.img: a long empty mall corridor ending in darkness, a green glow on the floor, a dry fountain in the foreground

lines.say: And if the speakers say the mall is closing… look down. Your bench is warm again.
lines.img: a single wooden mall bench under a skylight at night, empty, an indentation in the cushion as if someone just stood up

loop_back: The last line puts the viewer back on the bench where they woke up — the start of rule one.

gumi.say: Gumi here. Which rule would you break first? Be honest.
